# KR Brothers

> KR Brothers provides crane and Hydra rental, lifting, machinery shifting, loading and unloading, and breakdown recovery services from Khizarpur (Hajipur), Tehsil Mukerian, District Hoshiarpur, Punjab, India.

KR Brothers: +91 78890 87547; phone and WhatsApp: +91 97792 55878; email: krbrothers82@gmail.com; address: Vill. Khizarpur (Hajipur), Teh. Mukerian, Distt. Hoshiarpur, Punjab 144221, India; hours: 24 hours, 7 days.
